notes: MNN-Pocket-0.3B_int8.litertlm of litert-community/MNN-Pocket-0.3B: taobao-mnn/MNN-Pocket-0.3B (Apache-2.0; a ~300M-parameter instruction-tuned chat model, 28 layers, a 65,536-token Chinese and English vocabulary) converted to LiteRT-LM with a 4,096-token KV cache. This file replaced the first upload of the same name (sha256 7a62836b..., typed qwen2p5, measured before the replacement and never entered here) on 2026-11-07 (Hub commit 475036b0); main 6ea52447 at the read, 320025488 B, sha256 092a838999e99f4ab03239ca8de1c0caba01d1772d7a22909e76988b0b3dc1e9. Measured 2026-11-06 / 07 in the runs r8 (phones) and r10 (Mac) on these bytes. The phone GPU device line was run on a build with the same four sections (G3g), not on these bytes, and is not entered.
quantization: int8 weights (one scale per output channel, dynamic_wi8_afp32) with float activations, fp16 activations on the GPU (no activation type declared); KV cache 4,096 tokens; prefill signatures 128 and 1,024; attention composites (odml.qkv_norm_rope, odml.sdpa_transposed); model type generic_model
